topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: People always talk about the funny little secrets their neighbors hide. I've seen folks in threadbare suits and patched coats, living in charmless apartments, who suddenly pull out a stash of cash or a piece of jewelry that looks like it should be in a glass case. This city’s got more secrets than raindrops. When someone comes to me and whispers about their neighbor, suddenly flush with cash, I listen. I’ve learned to pay attention to the quiet ones, the ones who know how to keep their cards close. It’s not just about the money—it’s about what that money means. Everyone's got a story, and most of the time, it’s not the one they tell you first.
